explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1148 (resolved affirmatively by Chojecki, with a formal proof linked): every large n can be written as x² + y² - z² with max(x², y², z²) ≤ n. Truncated ℕ subtraction is harmless: for n ≥ 1, equality forces z² < x² + y², so the subtraction is genuine. A brute-force check up to 20000 finds 6563 as the largest exception, consistent with the page.
